title: Bounded-exponent sumsets obstruct one PIT route while nonmonomial features escape a monomial span bound
reported_status: The report states an unconditional exponent-box bound on scalarized iterated sumsets, applies it to one parameter regime printed in Narayanan ECCC Report 2026/138 Theorem 2, gives an all-degree span comparison, and exhibits a five-dimensional nonmonomial quadratic span with source-reported determinant -1. It also records two failed PIT mechanisms. The theorem-level literature comparison and all standalone exact checks remain unreviewed.
scientific_scope_status: The reported sumset argument rules out only the specified simultaneous expander parameter regime if the version-specific definitions and quantifiers are as transcribed; it does not refute the conditional implication, the paper's other theorems, VP != VNP, or general PIT. The nonmonomial example is a representation result, not a scalable zero-test. Exact matrix/code/receipt artifacts were not supplied; external correctness and priority remain UNKNOWN.
